                            routes[from_idx] = [x for x in routes[from_idx] if x != cust]

                            if current_max < best_max:

                elif nh == 'inter_swap':

                            current_max = current_max - best_delta

                                best_routes = [r[:] for r in routes]

                elif nh == 'intra_2opt':

                            improved_this_iter = True
                if improved_this_iter:
